name: orbitps2-manager
description: A modern, cross-platform way to manage your OPL game collection.
author: Luden

scripts.app:serve: npm run build:info && concurrently "npm run angular:serve" "npm run build:watch" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run electron:serve"
scripts.start: npm run build:info && npm run build && electron ./dist/src/main.js
scripts.package:win: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && node scripts/patch-fpm-rpm.js && PATH="$(brew --prefix binutils 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" electron-builder --linux && node scripts/patch-fpm-rpm.js
scripts.package:all: npm run remove && npm run build:info && cd angular && npm run build --omit=dev && cd .. && npm run build && node scripts/patch-fpm-rpm.js && PATH="$(brew --prefix binutils 2>/dev/null)/bin:$PATH" electron-builder --win --mac --linux && node scripts/patch-fpm-rpm.js && node scripts/collect-distributables.js
